reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: I am so very happy with New Century Landscaping, they have done a 1st class job! Paul & Matt who actually did the work are very friendly, hard working and did an amazing job! Dave who is the owner of the company is very friendly & gave me a great idea of what to do, really good company & workers would thoroughly recommend.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Dave and his team laid a new Indian stone path and patio, and refurbished the existing patio. It was completed to schedule and budget. … They respected the existing garden plantings and always left the site tidy. We would certainly recommend them to friends and neighbours.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Dave Leete and his lads did a small height 15.5 metre railway sleeper wall in my garden. … In all, a well done and professional job which looked good and was reasonably priced. I happily recommend this firm to others.
items.label: Which? review

quote.intro: Three quick steps and we’ll get back to you.

faqs.a: Yes. New Century Landscaping is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.

faqs.q: Do you work for developers as well as homeowners?
faqs.a: Yes. We work on everything from small terraced gardens to large commercial premises, for individual clients and property developers.

faqs.q: Can you build a garden from plans we already have?
faqs.a: Yes. We work closely with architects and surveyors and can build a complete garden from designs already drawn out.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 01923 224882. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
